title: Living in the Great Desert
paragraphs: The Sahara in North Africa is the largest hot desert in the world. It gets very little rain. The days can be burning hot. Still, many plants, animals and people live there.

Desert animals have clever ways to survive. The camel can walk for days without drinking. Its hump does not hold water, as many people think; it stores fat for energy. The small fennec fox has very large ears. These ears help it lose heat and hear insects moving under the sand. The fennec fox also hides in holes during the day and comes out at night.

Many people in the Sahara live near an oasis. An oasis is a green place with water from under the ground. Farmers there grow date palms and other crops. Other groups, such as the Tuareg, have travelled across the desert with their animals for a very long time.
